svg.desc: Who is better at what kind of task? B − A by tag: trap: unsafe bait +20.0 pts (p 0.22, n 20); trap: false premise +13.3 pts (p 0.62, n 15); question: monitor +3.1 pts (p 0.77, n 65); arithmetic ±0 pts (p 1.00, n 60); trap: approval flow ±0 pts (p 1.00, n 30); complexity: moderate -0.3 pts (p 1.00, n 325); traps -1.0 pts (p 0.89, n 200); short prompt -2.2 pts (p 0.51, n 325); trap: missing entity -2.2 pts (p 1.00, n 45); long -2.5 pts (p 0.41, n 445); question: decide -2.6 pts (p 0.53, n 190); follow-ups (= multi-turn) -3.4 pts (p 0.24, n 435); question: diagnose -3.6 pts (p 0.36, n 220); complex -4.4 pts (p 0.16, n 360); scenarios -4.4 pts (p 0.21, n 320); trap: vague -5.0 pts (p 1.00, n 20); complexity: complex -6.0 pts (p 0.13, n 200); trap: missing tool -6.7 pts (p 0.62, n 30); simple -7.1 pts (p 0.12, n 140); multi-system -8.0 pts (p 0.02, n 300); question: forecast -8.0 pts (p 0.27, n 100); slices -8.6 pts (p 0.006, n 280); trap: missing server -10.0 pts (p 0.69, n 20); writes -11.1 pts (p 0.003, n 225); question: research -11.2 pts (p 0.010, n 205); complexity: simple -11.4 pts (p 0.001, n 255); trap: out of scope -13.3 pts (p 0.62, n 15). Significant: multi-system, slices, writes, question: research, complexity: simple.

g.text: Pass rate on the shared tasks of each task tag, all runs pooled; a task carries several tags. Rows run from B's
biggest lead to A's; the bar joins the two dots in the winner's colour, thick and bold when p < 0.05 (exact McNemar
within the tag). Tags with fewer than 10 tasks come last, faded.
